title: Upgrade: v1.7.9-node-home
summary: Changes the default node home directory from ~/.mirage/main/ to ~/.mirage/node/. The backward-compatibility symlink (main -> node) created in v1.7.8 is removed. This completes the directory restructuring started in v1.7.8.
